summary.content:
Today's selection covers 90 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 56 on Artificial Intelligence and 20 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic Could Aim to Raise $100 Billion in Blockbuster I.P.O.
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: New SynkLoader malware pushed in Microsoft Teams phishing campaign
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 31 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.title: Anthropic Could Aim to Raise $100 Billion in Blockbuster I.P.O.
top.description: The offering could value the five-year-old A.I. start-up at $2 trillion, its bankers have told potential investors, which would exceed Elon Musk’s SpaceX.

top.description: The new AI security controls follow the Hugging Face incident last month, though many of these additions perhaps should have been in place prior to the frontier models escaping.
